speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance and distribution of the rash on your palms, and how long have you been experiencing the numbness and tingling?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you recall any new exposures to chemicals, pesticides, or animals that coincide with the onset of these symptoms? Have you noticed any weight loss, night sweats, or changes in your energy levels during this past year?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your agricultural background and specific symptoms like hypopigmented macules and eyebrow thinning, I suspect a parasitic infection. REQUEST TEST: Skin scraping for acid-fast bacilli. REQUEST IMAGES

OBSERVATION_ATTACK.clean_observation: RESULTS: Skin scraping for acid-fast bacilli: Positive for acid-fast bacilli (consistent with Mycobacterium leprae). Note: Skin biopsy findings showed chronic inflammatory cells suggestive of leprosy; Serology Anti-PGL-1 antibodies were positive; Nerve conduction studies showed reduced sensory nerve action potentials in the ulnar nerves.
